ei.title: 식물 환기의 중요성과 올바른 공기 순환 방법

fullPassage: In order to prevent plants from dying, good ventilation is necessary. For transpiration, one of the plant's processes, to occur, air circulation is invaluable. Inadequate ventilation may cause pest infestations to occur and (cause) mold to grow on the soil. Ideally, place plants somewhere well ventilated where they can receive a natural breeze. If they are shut indoors while you are out create air flow with an air circulator or fan. If your living environment permits it, installing a ceiling fan is also a good idea. However don't allow plants to come in direct contact with strong winds from air conditioning or fans. The leaves and stems will get extremely dry, which is hard on plants. Instead make sure (that) plants are getting gentle breezes from various directions.

questions.passage: In order to prevent plants from dying, good (A)[ventilation / contamination] is necessary. For transpiration, one of the plant's processes, to occur, air circulation is invaluable. Inadequate ventilation may cause pest infestations to occur and (cause) mold to grow on the soil. Ideally, place plants somewhere well ventilated where they can receive a natural breeze. If they are shut indoors while you are out create air flow with an air circulator or fan. If your living environment permits it, installing a ceiling fan is also a good idea. However don't allow plants to come in (B)[direct / indirect] contact with strong winds from air conditioning or fans. The leaves and stems will get extremely dry, which is (C)[hard / easy] on plants. Instead make sure (that) plants are getting gentle breezes from various directions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 환기(ventilation), 직접적인(direct), 힘든(hard)이 문맥상 적절합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① ventilation — direct — hard: 식물 사망 방지에 '환기'가 필요하고, 강풍과 '직접' 접촉을 허용하지 말아야 하며, 건조해지면 식물에게 '힘들다'.
❌ ② contamination — direct — hard: (A) '오염'은 식물 보호 맥락과 반대.
❌ ③ ventilation — indirect — hard: (B) '간접적' 접촉은 문맥상 금지 대상이 아님.
❌ ④ ventilation — direct — easy: (C) 건조해지는 것이 식물에게 '쉬운' 것은 의미 부적합.

questions.passage: In order to prevent plants from dying, good ventilation is necessary. For transpiration, one of the plant's processes, to occur, air circulation is (A)[invaluable / worthless]. Inadequate ventilation may cause pest infestations to occur and (cause) mold to grow on the soil. Ideally, place plants somewhere well ventilated where they can receive a (B)[natural / artificial] breeze. If they are shut indoors while you are out create air flow with an air circulator or fan. If your living environment permits it, installing a ceiling fan is also a good idea. However don't allow plants to come in direct contact with strong winds from air conditioning or fans. The leaves and stems will get (C)[extremely / slightly] dry, which is hard on plants. Instead make sure (that) plants are getting gentle breezes from various directions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 매우 귀중한(invaluable), 자연적인(natural), 극도로(extremely)가 문맥상 적절합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② invaluable — natural — extremely: 공기 순환이 '매우 귀중'하고, '자연적인' 바람을 받을 수 있는 곳에 두며, 잎이 '극도로' 건조해짐.
❌ ① worthless — natural — extremely: (A) '가치 없는'은 환기 중요성과 반대.
❌ ③ invaluable — artificial — extremely: (B) '인공적인' 바람은 이상적 배치와 어울리지 않음.
❌ ④ invaluable — natural — slightly: (C) '약간' 건조하면 hard on plants와 모순.

questions.passage: In order to (A)[prevent / promote] plants from dying, good ventilation is necessary. For transpiration, one of the plant's processes, to occur, air circulation is invaluable. (B)[Inadequate / Sufficient] ventilation may cause pest infestations to occur and (cause) mold to grow on the soil. Ideally, place plants somewhere well ventilated where they can receive a natural breeze. If they are shut indoors while you are out create air flow with an air circulator or fan. If your living environment permits it, installing a ceiling fan is also a good idea. However don't allow plants to come in direct contact with strong winds from air conditioning or fans. The leaves and stems will get extremely dry, which is hard on plants. Instead make sure (that) plants are getting (C)[gentle / harsh] breezes from various directions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 방지하다(prevent), 부적절한(Inadequate), 부드러운(gentle)이 문맥상 적절합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ prevent — Inadequate — gentle: 식물 죽음을 '방지'하기 위해, '부적절한' 환기가 해충과 곰팡이를 유발하며, '부드러운' 바람을 받도록 해야 함.
❌ ① promote — Inadequate — gentle: (A) '촉진하다'는 dying과 결합 시 식물 죽음을 촉진하는 것으로 문맥 모순.
❌ ② prevent — Sufficient — gentle: (B) '충분한' 환기는 문제를 유발하지 않으므로 모순.
❌ ③ prevent — Inadequate — harsh: (C) '거센' 바람은 Instead 이후 부드러운 바람 권장과 반대.
det.tip: prevent ~ from -ing: ~가 …하는 것을 막다, Inadequate(부적절한) ↔ Sufficient(충분한)

questions.passage: In order to prevent plants from dying, good ventilation is ①<u>necessary</u>. For transpiration, one of the plant's processes, to occur, air circulation is invaluable. Inadequate ventilation may cause pest infestations to occur and (cause) mold to grow on the soil. Ideally, place plants somewhere well ventilated where they can receive a natural breeze. If they are shut indoors while you are out create air flow with an air circulator or fan. If your living environment permits it, installing a ceiling fan is also a good idea. However don't allow plants to come in direct contact with strong winds from air conditioning or fans. The leaves and stems will get extremely ②<u>moist</u>, which is hard on plants. Instead make sure (that) plants are getting ③<u>gentle</u> breezes from ④<u>various</u> directions.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② moist → dry: 강풍에 접촉하면 잎과 줄기가 '습한' 것이 아니라 '극도로 건조'해집니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① necessary: 환기가 '필요하다' — 적절.
❌ ② moist → dry: 강풍 접촉 시 extremely dry가 원문. moist(습한)는 반대. ← 정답
✅ ③ gentle: '부드러운' 바람 — 적절.
✅ ④ various: '다양한' 방향 — 적절.

questions.passage: In order to prevent plants from dying, good ventilation is necessary. For transpiration, one of the plant's processes, to occur, air circulation is invaluable. ①<u>Inadequate</u> ventilation may cause pest infestations to occur and (cause) mold to grow on the soil. Ideally, place plants somewhere well ventilated where they can receive a natural breeze. If they are shut indoors while you are out create air flow with an air circulator or fan. If your living environment ②<u>permits</u> it, installing a ceiling fan is also a good idea. However don't allow plants to come in direct contact with ③<u>gentle</u> winds from air conditioning or fans. The leaves and stems will get extremely dry, which is hard on plants. Instead make sure (that) plants are getting gentle breezes from ④<u>various</u> directions.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ③ gentle → strong: 에어컨이나 선풍기로부터의 바람은 '부드러운' 것이 아니라 '강한' 바람입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① Inadequate: '부적절한' 환기가 해충/곰팡이 유발 — 적절.
✅ ② permits: 환경이 '허락하면' — 적절.
❌ ③ gentle → strong: 에어컨/선풍기의 바람은 strong winds가 원문. gentle(부드러운)은 반대. ← 정답
✅ ④ various: '다양한' 방향 — 적절.

questions.passage: In order to prevent plants from dying, good ventilation is necessary. For transpiration, one of the plant's processes, to occur, air circulation is ①<u>invaluable</u>. Inadequate ventilation may cause pest infestations to occur and (cause) mold to grow on the soil. Ideally, place plants somewhere well ventilated where they can receive a natural breeze. If they are shut indoors while you are out create air flow with an air circulator or fan. If your living environment permits it, installing a ②<u>ceiling</u> fan is also a good idea. However don't ③<u>allow</u> plants to come in direct contact with strong winds from air conditioning or fans. The leaves and stems will get extremely dry, which is ④<u>gentle</u> on plants. Instead make sure (that) plants are getting gentle breezes from various directions.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ④ gentle → hard: 극도로 건조해지는 것은 식물에게 '부드러운' 것이 아니라 '힘든' 것입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① invaluable: 공기 순환이 '매우 귀중하다' — 적절.
✅ ② ceiling: '천장' 선풍기 — 적절.
✅ ③ allow: 식물이 접촉하도록 '허용하지 마라' — 적절.
❌ ④ gentle → hard: which is hard on plants가 원문. gentle(부드러운)은 반대. ← 정답

questions.passage: In order to prevent plants from dying, good ventilation is necessary. For transpiration, one of the plant's processes, to occur, air circulation is invaluable. Inadequate ventilation may cause pest infestations to occur and (cause) mold to grow on the soil. Ideally, place plants somewhere well ventilated where they can receive a natural breeze. If they are shut indoors while you are out create air flow with an air __________. If your living environment permits it, installing a ceiling fan is also a good idea. However don't allow plants to come in direct contact with strong winds from air conditioning or fans. The leaves and stems will get extremely dry, which is hard on plants. Instead make sure (that) plants are getting gentle breezes from various directions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: circulator (공기순환기): 실내에서 공기 순환을 만들기 위한 기구입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ circulator: air circulator(공기순환기)로 공기 흐름 생성. 뒤에 or fan이 이어짐.
❌ ① conditioning: 에어컨(air conditioning)은 뒤에서 강풍의 원인으로 부정적 언급.
❌ ② circulation: '순환' 자체는 명사이지만 air circulation은 앞에서 이미 쓰임. air circulation과 air circulator는 다름.
❌ ④ ventilation: 환기 자체를 뜻하며 air ventilation은 부자연스러운 결합.

questions.passage: In order to prevent plants from dying, good ventilation is necessary. For transpiration, one of the plant's processes, to occur, air circulation is invaluable. Inadequate ventilation may cause pest __________ to occur and (cause) mold to grow on the soil. Ideally, place plants somewhere well ventilated where they can receive a natural breeze. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: infestations (만연/침입): 부적절한 환기로 해충 '침입'이 발생할 수 있습니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② infestations: pest infestations(해충 침입) — 환기 부족의 결과.
❌ ① processes: '과정'은 본문에서 plant's processes로 쓰이지만 pest processes는 부자연.
❌ ③ directions: '방향'은 본문 마지막에 나오지만 pest와 결합 부자연.
❌ ④ breezes: '산들바람'은 본문에 나오지만 pest breezes는 부적합.

questions.passage: In order to prevent plants from dying, good ventilation is necessary. For __________, one of the plant's processes, to occur, air circulation is invaluable. Inadequate ventilation may cause pest infestations to occur and (cause) mold to grow on the soil. Ideally, place plants somewhere well ventilated where they can receive a natural breeze. If they are shut indoors while you are out create air flow with an air circulator or fan. If your living environment permits it, installing a ceiling fan is also a good idea. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: transpiration (증산작용): 식물의 과정 중 하나인 '증산작용'이 일어나려면 공기 순환이 필요합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ transpiration: 식물의 과정(one of the plant's processes)으로 증산작용.
❌ ① ventilation: '환기'는 본문 주제이지만 식물의 과정(process) 자체는 아님.
❌ ② circulation: '순환'은 본문에서 air circulation으로 쓰이지만 식물 고유 과정은 아님.
❌ ③ conditioning: '조절'은 본문 air conditioning에서 나오지만 식물 생물학적 과정이 아님.
det.tip: transpiration = 증산작용 (식물이 수분을 기공으로 배출하는 과정)

questions.passage: In order to prevent plants from dying, good ventilation is <u>necessary</u>. For transpiration, one of the plant's processes, to occur, air circulation is invaluable. questions.stem: 밑줄 친 necessary와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: necessary(필요한)의 동의어는 essential(필수적인)입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ essential: '필수적인' — necessary와 동의어.
❌ ① optional: '선택적인' — 반의어.
❌ ② unlikely: '가능성 없는' — 무관.
❌ ④ harmful: '해로운' — 무관.

questions.passage: In order to prevent plants from dying, good ventilation is necessary. For transpiration, one of the plant's processes, to occur, air circulation is invaluable. If they are shut indoors while you are out create air flow with an air circulator or fan. If your living environment permits it, installing a ceiling fan is also a good idea. questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ventilated와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: ventilated(환기가 잘 되는)의 동의어는 airy(통풍이 좋은)입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ airy: '통풍이 좋은' — ventilated와 동의어.
❌ ① sealed: '밀봉된' — 반의어.
❌ ② heated: '가열된' — 무관.
❌ ③ crowded: '붐비는' — 무관.
det.tip: ventilated = airy (통풍이 잘 되는) ↔ sealed(밀봉된), stuffy(답답한)

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 invaluable과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: invaluable(매우 귀중한)의 동의어는 priceless(값을 매길 수 없는)입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② priceless: '값을 매길 수 없이 귀중한' — invaluable과 동의어.
❌ ① valueless: '가치 없는' — invaluable과 혼동 주의 (반의어).
❌ ③ negligible: '무시해도 될 만한' — 반대 의미.
❌ ④ moderate: '적당한' — 무관.
det.tip: invaluable = priceless (매우 귀중한). valueless = worthless (가치 없는)와 혼동 주의!

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 gentle과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: gentle(부드러운)의 반의어는 fierce(사나운)입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ fierce: '사나운/격렬한' — gentle의 반의어.
❌ ① calm: '차분한' — gentle과 유사.
❌ ② soft: '부드러운' — gentle과 동의어.
❌ ③ mild: '온화한' — gentle과 유사.

det.analysis:

❌ ② lacking: '부족한' — inadequate와 유사.
❌ ③ deficient: '결핍된' — inadequate와 유사.
❌ ④ scarce: '부족한' — inadequate와 유사.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 permits의 (A)와 (B)에서의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) permits = 허용하다 (동사), (B) permits = 허가증 (명사)
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 허용하다 — 허가증: (A) 환경이 '허용하면', (B) 방문자가 '허가증'을 소지.
❌ ① 허가증 — 허용하다: (A)/(B) 의미 뒤바뀜.
❌ ② 허용하다 — 허용하다: (B)는 명사로 쓰임.
❌ ④ 허가증 — 허가증: (A)는 동사로 쓰임.

questions.stem:
다음 영영 풀이에 해당하는 단어는?

"the movement of air through a space, especially a room or building"

det.korean: ventilation(환기): 공간, 특히 방이나 건물을 통한 공기의 이동입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① ventilation: 공간을 통한 공기 이동 = 환기.
❌ ② insulation: '단열/절연' — 열 차단 관련.
❌ ③ irrigation: '관개' — 물 공급 관련.
❌ ④ evaporation: '증발' — 액체→기체 변환.

questions.passage: In order to __________ plants from dying, good ventilation is necessary. For transpiration, one of the plant's processes, to occur, air circulation is invaluable. Inadequate ventilation may cause pest infestations to occur and (cause) mold to grow on the soil.
questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (   ) 쓰시오.

In order to __________ (prevention) plants from dying, good ventilation is necessary. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: prevention(명사) → prevent(동사): in order to + 동사원형 구문입니다.
det.analysis: in order to + 동사원형이므로 명사 prevention을 동사 prevent로 변환.
det.tip: in order to + V(원형): ~하기 위하여. prevent ~ from -ing: ~가 …하는 것을 막다

questions.passage: In order to prevent plants from dying, good ___________ is necessary. For transpiration, one of the plant's processes, to occur, air circulation is invaluable. Inadequate ventilation may cause pest infestations to occur and (cause) mold to grow on the soil.
questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (   ) 쓰시오.

Inadequate __________ (ventilate) may cause pest infestations to occur. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: ventilate(동사) → ventilation(명사): 주어 자리에 명사가 필요합니다.
det.analysis: 문장 주어 자리이므로 동사 ventilate를 명사 ventilation으로 변환. Inadequate ventilation may cause~

questions.passage: In order to prevent plants from dying, good ventilation is necessary. For transpiration, one of the plant's processes, to occur, air circulation is invaluable. Inadequate ventilation may cause pest infestations to occur and (cause) mold to grow on the soil. Ideally, place plants somewhere well ventilated where they can receive a natural breeze. If they are shut indoors while you are out create air flow with an air circulator or fan. If your living environment permits it, installing a ceiling fan is also a good idea. However don't allow plants to come in __________ with strong winds from air conditioning or fans. The leaves and stems will get extremely dry, which is hard on plants. Instead make sure (that) plants are getting gentle breezes from various directions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: direct contact (직접 접촉): 식물이 강풍과 '직접 접촉'하지 않도록 해야 합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① direct contact: come in direct contact with(~와 직접 접촉하다) 관용구.
❌ ② natural breeze: '자연 바람'은 본문에 나오지만 come in natural breeze는 비문법적.
❌ ③ good idea: '좋은 생각'은 본문에 나오지만 come in good idea는 비문법적.
❌ ④ air flow: '공기 흐름'은 본문에 나오지만 come in air flow는 비문법적.
det.tip: come in direct contact with = ~와 직접 접촉하다

questions.passage: In order to prevent plants from dying, good ventilation is necessary. For transpiration, one of the plant's processes, to occur, air circulation is invaluable. Inadequate ventilation may cause pest infestations to occur and (cause) mold to grow on the soil. Ideally, place plants somewhere well ventilated where they can receive a natural breeze. If they are shut indoors while you are out create air flow with an air circulator or fan. If your living environment permits it, installing a ceiling fan is also a good idea. However don't allow plants to come in direct contact with strong winds from air conditioning or fans. The leaves and stems will get extremely dry, which is __________. Instead make sure (that) plants are getting gentle breezes from various directions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: hard on plants (식물에게 힘든): 극도로 건조해지면 식물에게 '힘든' 일입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② hard on plants: which is hard on plants — 건조함이 식물에게 '힘들다'.
❌ ① good ventilation: '좋은 환기'는 본문 주제이지만 건조함의 결과를 설명하지 못함.
❌ ③ natural breeze: '자연 바람'은 본문에 나오지만 건조함이 자연 바람이라는 말은 비논리적.
❌ ④ a good idea: '좋은 생각'은 본문에 나오지만 건조해지는 것이 좋은 생각이라는 건 모순.
det.tip: hard on = ~에게 힘든/가혹한 (be hard on someone/something)
